messages:
anu: heads up — onboarding nova-lite (float32 -> int8 qk-1). found a detok/decoding quirk with corner quotes when CJK text follows an arabic/rtl segment. float32 OK, int8 fails.

anu: minimal repro: Translate to zh: "He said \"Good morning\" in Arabic: صباح" -> int8 output has the corner quotes reversed around the chinese phrase.

hyejin: can you paste tokenizer + encode/decode ids? staging only or local too?

anu: tokenizer=nova-sp (shared spm). repros on local int8 and staging canary. float32 decodes fine.

anu: small script I ran:
```
from redwood.tokenizer import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer('nova-sp')
s = "صباح ‘早上好’"
ids = tok.encode(s)
print(ids)
print(tok.decode(ids))
```
int8 decode -> shows flipped corner quotes, ids sequence matches float32.

omar: if ids same then likely detok table or fused kernel reorders codepoints under bidi flag. try alternate detok table or --no-bidi-normalize?

\hyejin: tried --no-bidi-normalize, no change. switching to detok_table_v1 on int8 fixes it. table_v2+fused-detok seems to trigger flip.

ci-bot: smoke run artifact: /runs/1789901234/nova-int8-smoke (150 mixed-locale samples). chrF down 0.77 -> 0.71; affected samples concentrated where CJK follows RTL fragment.

omar: I'll bisect detok_fuse changes and detok_table commits. need the smallest ascii/rtl/cjk combo to automate. anu shared a tiny repro.

anu: smallest failing string: "صباح 早上好" — only when Arabic precedes the quoted CJK phrase. gist: https://gist.github.com/anu/nova-detok-repro

omar: bisect points to a reorder introduced in detok_fuse commit a1b2c3 -> toggles mapping when has_rtl true. will open revert PR + add unit test to token-diff-suite covering mixed-orientation quotes.

sasha: good. plan: hotfix to force detok_table_v1 for has_rtl inputs on int8 -> canary -> revert + tests -> staged rollout. tag @eng-runtime.

runtime-bot: canary deploy started: nova-int8-hotfix -> ppool-6 at 1789901500

anu: will validate canary in ~10m and rerun smoke. will update here.
